title: 第11章 水衍珠的新能力第12章 击杀来犯之敌
content_zh:
李松鹤露出焦急的神色，心中暗自思量，这孙儿的法术竟已达至圆满级别，我手中这中品法器竟然难以破开他的防御，这该如何是好？
若是第一次对战就如此狼狈，岂不让人笑话？
正当他思索着是否该转换策略，尝试使用火属性法术以期打破僵局之际，李衍道的心念一动，只见三根锋利的冰锥自高空凝聚而成，直指李松鹤而来。
见此情形，李松鹤不敢怠慢，迅速调动飞剑迎击，冰锥与飞剑碰撞，发出清脆的响声。
尽管冰锥最终被飞剑击溃，但李松鹤却感到体内的灵力因此消耗了不少。
好在李松鹤毕竟已达炼气大圆满之境，其灵力之雄厚远非常人可比，足以支撑他与李衍道持续消耗下去。
然而，随着战斗的进行，李衍道凭借圆满级别的水流术，不仅加快了自己的移动速度，还频繁利用冰锥术发起攻势。
此时的战斗节奏，已完全被对方掌控。
李松鹤感受到体内灵力逐渐消耗，当仅剩两成之时，他发现对面的李衍道依旧游刃有余，攻势不减。
这令他不由眉头紧锁，心中焦急万分。
“停停停！”李松鹤急忙喊停了这场对战，面色略显苍白地走向李衍道，语气中带着几分疑惑与惊讶，“孙儿，为何你的灵力似乎无穷无尽一般？”
李衍道摸了摸脑袋，略带困惑地回答道：“我也不太清楚，不过现在我体内灵力大约还有三成左右。”
“什么？三成？我都只剩下不到两成了。”
李松鹤难以置信地回应，这一刻，他似乎意识到了什么重要的事情，整个人顿时变得震惊无比。
他和李衍道同修《玄水诀》，然而在灵力的雄浑程度上，李衍道的表现显然超越了自己。
这不仅仅是因为量上的差异，更重要的是质上的差距。
“孙儿，你的灵力精纯度比爷爷要高得多。这意味着你在每次施法时，我可能需要用两分灵力才能抵挡住你的一分灵力。
你平时是否有特别注重灵力的精纯度提升？”李松鹤解释道。
“灵力精纯？”李衍道听后，似懂非懂地点了点头。
他从来没有对灵力做过精纯，此刻，他恍然大悟，原来水衍珠除了提供灵力和加速修炼之外，还有第三个能力，那就是在不知不觉中精纯他体内的灵力。

“这就对了，没想到你竟然在炼气后期就已经开始了灵力的精纯，这通常是在达到炼气大圆满之后才会进行的事情。
修士在突破筑基期时，灵力精纯度非常关键，因为它直接关系到突破成功的几率。”李松鹤赞许地说道。
李衍道点了点头，似乎对自己的情况有了新的认识。
“爷爷，那我们还要继续对战吗？”
李松鹤摇了摇头，笑道：“不必了。以你现在展现出来的实力，绝对要比一般的炼气大圆满修士更强。
甚至可以媲美一些金丹势力中的筑基期种子弟子。
这样一来，我们家族面临的困境定能迎刃而解。”
“可是爷爷，我好像还没有真正经历过实战呢。”李衍道略带疑惑地说道。
“一切实战在真正实力面前都是徒劳的。你的实力已经相当了得，暂时并不需要通过更多的实战来磨炼。
content_en:
Li Songhe showed an anxious look and thought to himself, this grandson's magic has reached the perfect level, and the middle-grade magic weapon in my hand can't break through his defense. What should I do?
Wouldn't it be a joke if the first battle was so awkward?
Just as he was thinking about whether to change his strategy and try to use fire-attribute spells in order to break the deadlock, Li Yandao's mind moved and he saw three sharp ice picks condensed from high altitude, pointing directly at Li Songhe.
Seeing this situation, Li Songhe did not dare to neglect and quickly mobilized his flying sword to attack. The ice pick collided with the flying sword and made a crisp sound.
Although the ice cone was finally defeated by the flying sword, Li Songhe felt that a lot of spiritual energy in his body was consumed.
Fortunately, Li Songhe has reached the state of Qi Refining Great Perfection after all, and his spiritual power is far more powerful than anyone else's, enough to support him and Li Yandao's continued consumption.
However, as the battle progressed, Li Yandao relied on the perfect level of water flow technique to not only speed up his movement, but also frequently used the ice cone technique to launch attacks.
The rhythm of the battle at this time has been completely controlled by the opponent.
Li Songhe felt that the spiritual power in his body was gradually depleted. When only 20% was left, he found that Li Yandao on the opposite side was still able to do it with ease and his offensive continued unabated.
This made him frown and became extremely anxious.
"Stop, stop, stop!" Li Songhe hurriedly stopped the battle, and walked towards Li Yandao with a slightly pale face, with a bit of confusion and surprise in his tone, "Grandson, why does your spiritual power seem to be endless?"
Li Yandao touched his head and replied with a bit of confusion: "I'm not sure, but I still have about 30% of the spiritual power in my body."
"What? Thirty percent? I only have less than 20% left."
Li Songhe responded in disbelief. At this moment, he seemed to realize something important, and his whole body suddenly became extremely shocked.
He and Li Yandao both practiced "Xuanshui Jue", but in terms of the power of spiritual power, Li Yandao's performance clearly surpassed him.
This is not only a quantitative difference, but more importantly a qualitative difference.
"Grandson, the purity of your spiritual power is much higher than that of grandpa. This means that every time you cast a spell, I may need to use two points of spiritual power to resist one point of your spiritual power.
Do you usually pay special attention to improving the purity of your spiritual power? "Li Songhe explained.
"Pure spiritual power?" After hearing this, Li Yandao nodded as if he understood.
He had never purified his spiritual power. At this moment, he suddenly realized that in addition to providing spiritual power and accelerating his cultivation, Shui Yanzhu also had a third ability, which was to purify the spiritual power in his body without knowing it.
"That's right, I didn't expect that you would have started to purify your spiritual power in the late stage of Qi refining. This is usually done after reaching the Great Perfection of Qi refining.
When a monk breaks through the foundation building stage, the purity of his spiritual energy is very critical, because it is directly related to the chance of a successful breakthrough. "Li Songhe said approvingly.
Li Yandao nodded, seeming to have a new understanding of his situation.
"Grandpa, do we still want to continue fighting?"
Li Songhe shook his head and said with a smile: "No need. With the strength you are showing now, you are definitely stronger than the average Qi Refining Dzogchen cultivator.
It is even comparable to some foundation-building stage seed disciples among the Jindan forces.
In this way, the difficulties faced by our family will be easily solved. "
"But grandpa, it seems that I haven't really experienced actual combat." Li Yandao said with a little doubt.
"All actual combat is in vain in the face of true strength. Your strength is already quite impressive, and there is no need to hone it through more actual combat for the time being.
